unavailable.title: Profile unavailable
unavailable.description: Open your account to view your profile.

visibility.private: Your profile is private — other people can't see it, and your username won't show up in search.
visibility.public: Your profile is public — anyone can find it by your username or public ID.

header.verifiedHint: This name is publicly confirmed and tamper-proof.

noPublicSkills.title: No public skills
noPublicSkills.description: {name} hasn't shared any skills publicly yet.

error.offlineHint: This profile is shared directly by its owner. They need to be online, and their profile set to public.

talentIndex.title: Publish to talent index
talentIndex.description: Employers can search a talent index for people with verified skills. Nothing here is published unless you choose it, and you can change your mind at any time.
talentIndex.nothingSelected: You haven't chosen anything to publish. Nothing about you appears in any talent index.
talentIndex.noSkills: You don't have any verified skills yet. Once you earn one, it will appear here as something you can choose to publish.
talentIndex.identityNote: Without these, a listing shows your skills and your public ID, but not your name.
talentIndex.previewHeading: Exact record that would leave this device
talentIndex.notPublishedYet: No talent index is connected yet, so nothing is being sent anywhere. These choices apply when one is.
